notes.title: MIMI BROUGHT NEWS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240635/0bbe02efd902d2ecb8388ff6412c718b91a70db4.png[/img]
[i]Mimi chatted with some friends, and they helped with updates to her game.[/i]
[h2]First we fixed the following BUGS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] In the main menu, if you do a set of specific actions, the MENU will disappear.
[*] Sound distortion when pressing Hint (Q) in the end animation of the level.
[*] Mouse enters “sleep” mode and does not appear again when changing game levels. This was a serious problem.
[*] Movement: There was a difference if you used a different set of buttons, they responded differently to Mimi's movement.
[*] There was an animation of Mimi going through some boxes by jumping on her, we changed that a bit too.
[/list]

[b]We are reviewing the game, but if you find any of these BUGs or new BUGs, please let us know in our community hub.[/b]

[h2]In the interfaces, we made the following changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Best indication of selected language. There is now a red contrast in the selected language.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240635/579282f8a0e5d9c1b7ce4b1a38930d24119e2ab1.png[/img]

[list]
[*] It is possible to change the selected language in the game settings.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240635/65b5ff826ff0aa02b308fd16e7c89eedfeef89ff.png[/img]

[list]
[*] There is an indication of the phase in the internal menu of the game, it is practical to share with your friend which phase you are in.
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240635/6af10ad7bba22a0494dd7b350f1c3c335993b8b8.png[/img]

[b][h3]Changed levels 13/14[/h3][/b]
We had feedback that we had not taught how to stack boxes through game design. This issue was addressed by changing the order of the stages.

[b][h3]Effects sound feedback[/h3][/b]
By adjusting the game effect volume, you get instant feedback.

[b][h3]New Tutorial screen[/h3][/b]
We implemented a new tutorial system. 
It is presented before the first level, and in case you have any doubts, it appears in the internal menu of the game with the icon and also has the buttons mapped.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240635/f43605bc0e9c5c94fe7642efe5b7770e650526d8.png[/img]

notes.title: MIMI FOUND SOMETHING IN THE BOXES
notes.content:
[h3]Mimi, on one of her adventures, bumped into a new box that we had lost.[/h3]
[b]She found the box where the languages were! [/b]🗨
The following languages have been added to the game:

[list]
[*] Português-Brazil
[*] Deustche
[*] Español
[*] Français
[*] Русский
[*] 简体中文
[*] 日本語
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240635/4004bd4a527d8b8fd7548c23c4a0ae8b2a42bcef.png[/img]

[h3]Not satisfied, our curious cat went looking for what was in other boxes...[/h3]	
[b]And guess what! She found our gamepad! [/b]
	As you can see, Mimi is very effective in giving us new tasks. We were able to implement a partial gamepad 🎮 system for movement and in-game actions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240635/5ebd53b4a92ca3f50260757596a27e68469834ab.png[/img]

notes.title: Bug Fix - New Update!
notes.content:
We received some feedback of minor bugs in an advanced level of the game.
To be more precise, at the last level.

We made this update and added a surprise for you. A new secret achievement. Only the most dedicated adventurers have achieved this achievement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240635/7d36f1b5c3f1f4ddd4bccafdb2234c6ebe07116b.png[/img]
Again, [b]thanks [/b]for the feedback.
[i]Don't forget to let us know what you think of this update on our Community HUB![/i]

notes.title: Bug Fix - New update!
notes.content:
We received some reports talking about a possible error at this level.
We did some tests and you guys were totally right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240635/728463c47ef62583bfba48b80fe8dac0070c7771.png[/img]

Mimi thinks it was her brother, Branquinho, who took her box. We take a new box for Mimi. Now both are happy.
Effectively, we made a bug fix in phase 48.


We also took the opportunity to update the audio system. Now the music is lower.

Again, thanks for the feedback.

notes.title: Cats and Sokoban - Mimi's Scratcher is here. Play it now!
notes.content:
[b]We are happy to announce our new release:[/b]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40007110/2c99195f7b3176193c4fdf25826de2da2b1fe7fd.png[/img]

Cats and SokoBan – Mimi’s Scratcher is a sokoban type game in which you can push boxes, stack boxes and even jump between platforms, when necessary, so that Mimi the cat can reach her scratching post and have fun.
Look the level carefully, there is no time limit, no resources to manage, so you can calmly focus on solving the challenges.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40007110/6ad9e5774fefbe7dbfbd46aa7e47bc29070d1129.png[/img]

Our team loved making this game. Mimi is a cat owned by one of the staff members, she is very cute.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] 50 handcrafted levels.
[*] Stack boxes.
[*] Catchy soundtrack.
[*] Jump between platforms, like a good cat would.
[*] Minimalist interface and gameplay.
[*] 12 backgrounds for you to choose which is pleasant;
[*] Restart level.
[*] Fun and sweet sokoban with relaxing.
[*] Mimi, the cutest one that will warm your heart ♥
[/list]

You can get it now at a good discount and play it for many hours:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2222770/Cats_and_Sokoban__Mimis_Scratcher/
